interface.shortDescription: Search GeoNames places, walk admin hierarchies, reverse geocode, get postal codes and country info.
interface.longDescription: Geographic grounding from GeoNames, the gazetteer of 13M+ places worldwide, each keyed by a stable integer geonameId. Search places by name, country, feature class or code, population tier, and bounding box; read a place's full record with its admin chain, timezone, elevation, alternate names, postal codes, and IATA, UN/LOCODE, and Wikidata identifiers; climb a place's parent chain to its continent, or list a feature's children in the administrative, tourism, geography, or dependency tree; reverse-geocode a coordinate to its country and subdivisions, or the ocean offshore, with the nearest places or features and an optional timezone; look up postal codes by code, place name, or point across 122 countries; and read country facts such as ISO codes, capital, population, languages, and currency. Calls spend credits from a free GeoNames account, set once as GEONAMES_USERNAME or passed per call as geonamesUsername. GeoNames data is CC BY 4.0: credit GeoNames when passing results on.
